english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is capable and gets the job done.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 si1 fu6 zou6 je5 hou2 dim6

english.note: Use this when capable means proven to be good enough or able to handle the job.

exampleSentences.english: I know you are capable of handling this job.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢單嘢交畀你做，我知你一定掂。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 daan1 je5 gaau1 bei2 nei5 zou6 ngo5 zi1 nei5 jat1 ding6 dim6
